model.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Dante's Lemons, a premium 0.5g live rosin cartridge that delivers exceptional flavor and potency in a convenient 510 thread format. This Live Rosin Cart captures the essence of fresh cannabis through solventless extraction, preserving the plant's full terpene profile for an authentic, strain-specific experience. Dante's Lemons bursts with bright citrus notes dominated by zesty lemon and tangy citrus flavors, creating a mouthwatering profile that's both refreshing and bold. Each draw offers smooth vapor packed with aromatic terpenes and full-spectrum cannabinoids. The live rosin extraction method ensures you're getting cannabis-derived terpenes and a clean, pure concentrate without any additives or cutting agents. Compatible with any standard 510 thread battery, this cartridge makes it easy to enjoy premium live rosin on the go. Perfect for those seeking flavorful, high-quality concentrates with natural effects and true-to-plant taste.
